title: Queue Imbalance as a One-Tick-Ahead Price Predictor in a Limit Order Book

claims.interpretation: Fit a Bernoulli logistic model with intercept and one imbalance coefficient by maximum likelihood.

assumptions: Label is direction of the next nonzero midprice change.
Fit training partition only; serialization and reload precede holdout inference.
deviations: Uses every quote and chronological split instead of randomized sampling/splitting.
The paper predicts prices; threshold-based target positions are an explicitly added trading policy.
No local logistic variant or proprietary NASDAQ sample; simulation performance is not paper performance.
mapping_review: Repository author mapping checked against cited source pages; anchors prove provenance, mathematical tests check implementation; external review remains independent.
